headline: SFG @ LAD matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SFG 3.17 at LAD 5.30, with a projected total of 8.47. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward LAD: SFG moved -0.14 runs while LAD moved +0.58, changing the projected margin by -0.72 runs. The projected total climbed +0.45, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -21.1%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Yoshinobu Yamamoto has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available start logs at 2.2 ER over the last 5 starts. Batter research is strongest for Rafael Devers, Luis Arraez, Andy Pages, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Matt Chapman, Patrick Bailey because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
